title: Unread evidence is omitted from recall not counted as a miss
description:
As a scanner engineer, I want unread evidence omitted from recall, so that missing language ingest does not look like a miss.

Feature: Unread evidence is not a miss

  Scenario: Unread file is omitted from recall
    Given a gold Item whose evidence file the scanner did not ingest
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy
    Then that Item is not counted as a No
    And that Item is not in the recall denominator

  Scenario: Ingested miss still counts
    Given a gold Item whose evidence file the scanner ingested
    And no overlapping finding
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy
    Then that Item counts as a miss

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Unread omit from recall covered by scanner-recall-evaluation.feature on feature/DATAP-af2f48; Plexus Scorecard records SKIPPED for SkippedScoreException.
